# Why Bodhidharma is spelled that way — and what it costs to get it right

There is no broken version of this name to repair. There is a record to preserve: **Bodhidharma**, exactly as the scholarly convention supports it.

Bodhidharma’s mythology is a layer-cake of history and legend: the historical missionary of the early sixth century; the wall-gazer of the Zen records; the Shaolin temple’s patron of the martial arts; and Japan’s round Daruma doll, whose blank eyes you fill in when your wish comes true. The legend grew because the teaching needed a body — and the body it chose was defiant, foreign, and perfectly still.

## At a Glance

- **Restored name:** Bodhidharma
- **ASCII form:** bodhidharma
- **Meaning:** "Dharma of awakening"
- **Domain of influence:** Zen Patriarch, Wall-Gazer
- **Pantheon:** Chinese
- **Restoration:** ASCII-equivalent form
- **Original script:** 菩提達磨
- **Series:** The Restoration Files, No. 97 of 597

## The Name Before the Marks

The name is attested as **菩提達磨**, as Transmission of the Lamp (Jingde Record of the Transmission) and Blue Cliff Record (Hekiganroku), case 1 record. On the evidence, it means "Dharma of awakening".


Spoken, the name runs `/ˌboʊdɪˈdɑːrmə/` — “boh-dee-DAR-muh”

## The Temple That Stands Now

The restored name is not a plaque; it is an address. The temple of **Bodhidharma** lives at [/bodhidharma/](/bodhidharma/), with its mythology in the [lore halls](/bodhidharma/lore/), its peer-reviewed record in the [Scholarly Edition](/bodhidharma/scholars/), and its place in the pattern atlas on the [patterns floor](/bodhidharma/patterns/).

The displayed form is ASCII-equivalent.

## Where the Name Stood First

His supposed grave at Kongxiangsi in the Pagoda Forest of Shaolin carries the earliest memorials; the Shaolin steles of the Tang dynasty name him. The Daruma doll’s manufacture is a modern industry, but the blank-eyed scowl descends from the Muromachi portraits. The temple on the web is the newest of these addresses — the first one that fits in a pocket.

## The Archetype at Work

The [pattern atlas](/patterns/) seats this temple in **3 industries**, each match argued and weighted: **Sports, Fitness & Competition** (the Shaolin arts' legendary founder — body-discipline as transmitted practice.); **Yoga, Meditation & Holistic Wellness** (the First Patriarch of Zen — zazen, the wall-facing sitting, is his nine years made daily.); **Mental Health & Emotional Wellness** (nine years facing the wall — the tradition's image of the mind trained past distraction.). The [Resonance File](/bodhidharma/blog/resonance/) reads those seats through the myths themselves.

## In the Sacred Texts

The Chinese tradition is not a vibe; it is a library. The [Sacred Texts collection](/texts/) holds [Tao Te Ching](/texts/tao-te-ching/) — the primary sources the temple's scholarship is built on. The temple is the argument; the texts are the evidence.
